description: Abstract class defining virtual input handling for cross-platform input in Unity, including management of virtual axes and buttons, and virtual mouse position.

classes.name: VirtualInput
classes.description: Abstract class for managing virtual input axes, buttons, and mouse position in Unity.

methods.name: AxisExists
methods.description: Checks if a virtual axis with the given name exists.

methods.name: ButtonExists
methods.description: Checks if a virtual button with the given name exists.

methods.name: RegisterVirtualAxis
methods.description: Registers a new virtual axis, logs error if axis with same name exists.

methods.name: RegisterVirtualButton
methods.description: Registers a new virtual button, logs error if button with same name exists.

methods.name: UnRegisterVirtualAxis
methods.description: Removes a virtual axis by name.

methods.name: UnRegisterVirtualButton
methods.description: Removes a virtual button by name.

methods.name: VirtualAxisReference
methods.description: Returns reference to a virtual axis if it exists, otherwise null.

methods.name: SetVirtualMousePositionX
methods.description: Sets the virtual mouse position's X coordinate.

methods.name: SetVirtualMousePositionY
methods.description: Sets the virtual mouse position's Y coordinate.

methods.name: SetVirtualMousePositionZ
methods.description: Sets the virtual mouse position's Z coordinate.

methods.name: GetAxis
methods.description: Abstract method to get axis value.

methods.name: GetButton
methods.description: Abstract method to check if button is pressed.

methods.name: GetButtonDown
methods.description: Abstract method to check if button was just pressed.

methods.name: GetButtonUp
methods.description: Abstract method to check if button was just released.

methods.name: SetButtonDown
methods.description: Abstract method to simulate button press.

methods.name: SetButtonUp
methods.description: Abstract method to simulate button release.

methods.name: SetAxisPositive
methods.description: Abstract method to set axis to positive direction.

methods.name: SetAxisNegative
methods.description: Abstract method to set axis to negative direction.

methods.name: SetAxisZero
methods.description: Abstract method to reset axis to zero.

methods.name: SetAxis
methods.description: Abstract method to set axis to specific value.

methods.name: MousePosition
methods.description: Abstract method to get current mouse position.
